reports.description:
On June 10th, at approximately 4PM, just before my family and I sat down for dinner, I checked my youtube account one last time - as I was expecting a notification from a podcast channel I subscribe to. 
_x000D_
I had not yet received the notification I was anticipating but the first thing I saw but a live recommended stream from Youtube with approximately 125k watching and several thousand ‚Äòthumbs up‚Äô of Jeff Bezos participating in a talk. A banner appeared on the video and in the description detailing a limited bitcoin giveaway with 50% return as a way to introduce cryptocurrency to Amazon while supplies last. Out of 5000 BTC, only 81 remained. I quickly tried to vet the channel. It had what appeared to be almost a million subscribers and Youtube was recommending the stream as #1 so I decided to transfer .51 BTC to the address listed - 1BezosGRe9LN7kD1W2WUpXqfYX3qYX2GXp. _x000D_
_x000D_
I closed my computer and ate dinner. A few hours later, I logged back in to check the transaction and quickly realized that I had been scammed._x000D_
_x000D_
I am gutted by this and I feel embarrassed. I don‚Äôt have a lot of money and the .51 BTC I sent was my Easter egg lotto ticket for the future. I know that I will never see it again._x000D_

I do not want this to happen to anyone else. It‚Äôs a terrible feeling.
